messages:
Linda (CS): Heads-up — we just flagged an onboarding impact for a segment of new tenants. ~12 customers experiencing failed webhook handshakes (401) during initial webhook validation. Seeing increased support tickets and a couple of at-risk renewals. Need a concise customer update + targeted outreach plan. Can Eng confirm root cause and ETA for a fix?
ops-bot: deploy-rollback: rollback initiated at 2026-03-21T14:12:00Z for service webhook-validator by @tom-eng.
Tom (Eng): Root cause = stricter header validation in yesterday's deploy that rejected some onboarding webhook signatures when requests were proxied through certain CDNs. Rolled back to previous build (rollback success). Hotfix in PR, running tests; can ship a progressive deploy in ~2 hours. Suggest wording: "We've rolled back the change and are restoring normal webhook onboarding. A small number of clients saw intermittent authentication failures during sign-up."
Maria (CS): Thanks — can we get a CSV of affected tenants + account tiers? I want to split outreach: 1) high-touch enterprise (manual outreach + credit), 2) self-serve / SMB (email template + FAQ). Also flag renewal window <60 days.
Kevin (Support): I have 7 open tickets that match this pattern (IDs attached in ticketing). For enterprise customers, support can open a dedicated session. We should promise specific remediation steps and an SLA credit if onboarding failed for >24h.
Jess (Onboarding): I'll run two live office hours today and tomorrow for affected customers who need guided onboarding. Proposed slots: 2026-03-21 17:00 PT, 2026-03-22 09:00 PT. I can include a short checklist and a shared workspace invite.
Linda (CS): Draft customer note (short, to be personalized by tier):

"Hi <CustomerName> — we’re sorry for the onboarding interruption. We detected authentication failures for some webhook registrations after a recent deploy. We rolled back the change and are restoring normal operations. Our engineers will deploy a fix in a progressive rollout; we will follow up when your tenant is fully validated. If this impacted your onboarding flow, we’re offering a one-time service credit and a prioritized assist session. Office hours (sign up link): <link>. Reply here if you want a 1:1 walkthrough. — Linda & Redwood CS"

Linda (CS): Please adapt the bracketed bits and include account-specific contact if enterprise.
Maria (CS): For enterprise outreach, let's append renewal-reassurance language: "We recognize onboarding disruptions are unacceptable; your success is our priority. We will provide a detailed RCA and a credit where appropriate. Your CSM <Name> will follow up directly."
Tom (Eng): Confirming timeline: hotfix tested in staging now. Expected progressive rollout starts 2026-03-21T16:45Z, completes by 2026-03-21T17:30Z if no regressions. We'll monitor error rate and webhook handshake success. Fallback: if a tenant still fails, we can temporarily bypass strict header validation for their tenant ID (manual toggle) until we stabilize.
Kevin (Support): Good. I'll prepare individualized threads tying ticket IDs to tenant CSV. Also recommend we include a short kb entry: "What to do if webhook returns 401 during onboarding" with a one-click revalidate button flow.
Jess (Onboarding): I'll draft the office-hours invite and the one-page checklist. Also want to capture feedback during the session: 2 quick questions — 1) Did this impact your go-live timeline? 2) Was the remediation/support helpful? We'll store responses in the onboarding dashboard.
Linda (CS): Action items (owner): Maria — segmentation + email templates (30m). Tom — confirm rollout start + monitoring channel (30m). Kevin — attach ticket threads + KB draft (45m). Jess — office-hours link + enablement doc (1h). I'll coordinate exec communication for renewals flagged as high-risk. Please add notes to the shared spreadsheet: <sheet link>.
Maria (CS): One more ask — include suggested credit language amounts by tier so finance can pre-approve: e.g., SMB: $50 credit, Growth: $250, Enterprise: case-by-case.
Tom (Eng): Acknowledged. We'll post progress in #eng-runtime and update this thread when rollout completes.
Kevin (Support): I'll CC CSMs on each outreach and add the SLA credit rationale to the ticket comments.
Linda (CS): We want to capture feedback and reps' sentiment — Jess, please collect session notes and paste the top 3 pain points here after the first office hour.
Jess (Onboarding): Will do. Also planning a short post-session survey link: <feedback form link>. Two free-text prompts + the two quick questions.
Maria (CS): If anyone needs a templated enterprise RCAs summary to send to execs, ping me and I’ll produce a one-pager.
Tom (Eng): Rollout started at 2026-03-21T16:46Z. Early telemetry shows handshake success back to baseline for 60% of affected tenants. Monitoring continues.
Linda (CS): Thanks team. Final sign-off on customer-facing copy by 2026-03-21T16:30Z pls. I'll send the tailored emails and enablement invites once we have the tenant list. :thumbsup:
Maria (CS): Copy received, will deliver CSV and segmented templates in 20 mins.
Kevin (Support): Tickets updated with rollback note and credit placeholders.
Jess (Onboarding): Office-hours invites sent for both slots, sign-up link included in templates.
Tom (Eng): Rollout completed at 2026-03-21T17:29Z; error rate back to normal. Will hand off final RCA draft in ~2 business days.
Linda (CS): Great work — let's capture lessons learned in the onboarding playbook. Please paste any follow-ups into the sheet. Closing this thread after outreach batch completes. :sparkles:
